spanish: Decidle al rey y a la reina: Sed humildes y sentaos, porque caerán de sus cabezas las coronas de su gloria.

findings.issue: 2mp suffixes rendered as 3rd-person sus/su instead of direct 2nd-person address
singular עֲטֶרֶת rendered as plural coronas
qal perfect יָרַד rendered as future caerán

notes: also shifts from direct 2mp address to reported speech about the addressees
